title: DOJ seeks $1.17 billion in USDC tied to Binance hack; Circle could issue replacement tokens
reason: DOJ action to recover $1.17B tied to the Binance hack plus possible USDC reissuance is a materially large, sourced development.

sources.summary: The U.S. Justice Department is seeking to recover about $1.17 billion in USDC tied to the Oct. 29 Binance hack.
